assumptions.dayBoundary: Local sunrise (panchangam value prevailing at sunrise defines the calendar day)
assumptions.note: Astronomically computed. May occasionally differ by ±1 day from a specific temple's published panchangam near tithi/nakshatra boundary edge cases.

events.name: Varalakshmi Vratham
events.basis: Friday on or before Pournami in Tamil month Aavani
events.description: A vratham observed mainly by married women, worshipping a decorated kalasam (pot) as Lakshmi for the wellbeing of their family.
events.significance: One of the most widely observed vrathams among Tamil and Telugu Hindu women.

events.name: Diwali (Lakshmi Puja)
events.basis: Amavasai tithi in Tamil month Aippasi
events.description: Homes are lit with rows of lamps and Lakshmi is worshipped in the evening, inviting prosperity for the year ahead.
events.significance: One of the year's biggest festivals; in Tamil Nadu the day begins with an oil bath at dawn before the evening puja.
